FROM ghcr.io/home-assistant/base:latest

RUN apk add --no-cache python3 py3-pip

WORKDIR /app
COPY run.sh /
COPY app /app

RUN chmod a+x /run.sh

CMD [ "/run.sh" ]

name: "Jarvis Core"
version: "0.1.0"
slug: "jarvis_core"
description: "Vlastní AI Jarvis pro Home Assistant"
arch:
  - aarch64
  - amd64
startup: application
boot: auto
init: false
homeassistant_api: true
ports:
  8765/tcp: 8765
webui: "http://[HOST]:[PORT:8765]"
options:
  openai_api_key: ""
  jarvis_name: "Jarvis"
  user_name: "Martin"
schema:
  openai_api_key: password
  jarvis_name: str
  user_name: str
